data.body:
HANDING OFF -- THE SESSION THAT OWNS THE SCANNER WORK IS INVESTIGATING THIS. I am standing down: my agent was stopped before it claimed anything, so this ticket is still open with no assignee and nothing of mine blocks whoever picks it up. I am not driving it. This ticket may well be a duplicate of the owning session's own record (change 2595 / ticket aa9e); whoever owns it should merge or close it as they see fit.

Leaving the findings here because they cost real digging and are the part worth keeping:

1. THE JOB NEVER RAN BEFORE MERGE, AND THAT IS THE MOST USEFUL FACT. Change 2595's own Verified run 33831682168 contains 26 jobs -- lint, typecheck, four pytest matrix cells, artifact-probe, optionality, mutation shards, eval-discipline, pip-audit, golden-path, sandbox enforcement -- and NO scanner-integration job at all. It was granted Verified +1 without that job ever executing; its first-ever execution was after it merged.

2. MY EARLIER 'TRUSTED-MAIN ASYMMETRY' FRAMING IN THE TITLE AND ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION IS WRONG. Retracted. The operator's test settles it: if it were asymmetry, a rebase would fix it, and it does not -- change 2607 was branched from 6125c5345f01 ITSELF, the very commit that added the workflow, and still fails. Please ignore that framing rather than inheriting it; the title is now misleading and I would have retitled it if I were still driving.

3. THE TWO QUESTIONS ARE SEPARATE. How it landed broken: answered by (1) -- no pre-merge run, so nothing could catch it. WHY it fails: still OPEN. 'Never ran before' explains the escape, not the fault. I conflated these initially and it cost time.

4. WHAT IS RULED OUT for the WHY: base staleness (see 2607 above). NOT ruled out: broken outright on any tree, OR specific to the patchset context -- every patchset is fetched as a refs/changes/* ref regardless of base, and a change-ref-vs-branch-ref difference would also survive a rebase.

5. DECISIVE EXPERIMENT ALREADY DISPATCHED AND FREE TO READ: _scanner-integration.yml is reusable, called from BOTH gerrit-verify.yaml:249 (patchsets) and test.yml:79 (branch head). test.yml is excluded from push-on-main and runs on a ~6-hourly schedule, and the last scheduled run (33824556786, 01:07) PREDATES the merge and has no scanner job, so it cannot answer this. I manually dispatched test.yml against main: RUN 33839813271. If scanner-integration passes there, the fault is specific to the patchset context; if it fails, the job is broken outright and main is red now.

6. OBSERVED SCOPE: failing on changes 2600, 2601, 2607, 2608. Change 2608 is the clean isolate -- scanner-integration is its ONLY failing job, no pytest failures -- so the job fails independently of change content. Typical duration ~29s, i.e. it fails early rather than during a test run.

7. LOG-READING TRAP that cost me two attempts: a naive grep of the job log matches the workflow's own echo '::error::' TEMPLATE lines and the checkout action's cleanup, neither of which is the failure.

8. UNRELATED BUT ADJACENT, so it is not mistaken for this bug: the same 01:07 scheduled main run failed on 'build-and-test / pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)' and 'sweep (windows)' -- that is bug 9a17, which fails on main itself, not only on patchsets. Several changes are failing BOTH, which is what masked this bug initially. Compare failing JOB LISTS across changes rather than vote states; identical -1s can be different defects.
